prompt: Our shy shelter cat is growing (brave) and (brave) around visitors' trainers.
explanation_ru: Постепенное усиление признака короткого прилагательного brave передаётся конструкцией braver and braver (всё смелее и смелее).

prompt: The (slowly) you cook the tomatoes, the (sweet) the sauce tastes.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «чем…, тем…» (the…, the…) в первой части нужно наречие more slowly (к глаголу cook), а во второй — прилагательное sweeter (после tastes).

prompt: Last year, the old market square was a noisy car park that nobody liked. After cars were banned, wooden chess tables appeared under the trees. The square feels more and (lively) on sunny afternoons, and (few) and (few) drivers complain about the change. Local cafes stay full until evening.
explanation_ru: После more and требуется повторить more (more and more lively), а с исчисляемым существительным drivers постепенное уменьшение передаётся через fewer and fewer.

prompt: Anouk told residents that the (brightly) the new porch lights shine, the (safe) their garden sheds stay at night.
explanation_ru: В парном союзе the…, the… глагол shine требует наречия more brightly, а глагол-связка stay — прилагательного safer.

prompt: Our little oak tree stretches (wide) and (wide) over the porch swing.
explanation_ru: Короткое слово wide при описании постепенного роста удваивается в сравнительной степени через and: wider and wider.

prompt: With bright new screens, our artists finish backgrounds ___ on weekdays.
explanation_ru: Короткое наречие fast образует двойную сравнительную степень через суффикс -er: faster and faster; использовать more с fast — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Remember that little harbour bakery? I bought coffee and two sweet buns there with my sister. The buns are getting (small) and smaller, while the bill grows more and (expensive). I might simply bake at home!
explanation_ru: Для короткого прилагательного small используется smaller and smaller, а для длинного expensive — more and more expensive.

prompt: Nobody tries to show off at our reunion anymore, so the evening feels ___ every year.
explanation_ru: Короткое прилагательное warm удваивается в форме -er без слова more: warmer and warmer.

prompt: Claudia noticed that the (often) retired neighbours walked in the park, the (deeply) they slept at night.
explanation_ru: В обеих частях конструкции the…, the… стоят наречия, образующие сравнительную степень через more: the more often…, the more deeply…

prompt: Henrik reported that the faster the wooden boat sailed across the choppy bay, more steadily its rebuilt rudder held the line.
answer: Henrik reported that the faster the wooden boat sailed across the choppy bay, the more steadily its rebuilt rudder held the line.
accepted_answers: Henrik reported that the faster the wooden boat sailed across the choppy bay, the more steadily its rebuilt rudder held the line.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — пропуск артикля the во второй части конструкции «чем…, тем…»; правильно — the faster…, the more steadily…

prompt: Why does the harbour walk get (busy) and (busy) in September?
explanation_ru: У прилагательного busy на -y сравнительная степень образуется через -ier; для постепенного нарастания нужно busier and busier.

prompt: When I practise my interview answers aloud more, my voice sounds calmer. → The more …
answer: The more I practise my interview answers aloud, the calmer my voice sounds.
accepted_answers: The more I practise my interview answers aloud, the calmer my voice sounds.
The more I practise my interview answers aloud, the calmer my voice will sound.
explanation_ru: Причинно-следственная связь «чем больше…, тем спокойнее…» строится по модели The more + подлежащее + глагол, the calmer + подлежащее + глагол.

prompt: Silje wrote that the (regularly) the choir practised breathing warm-ups on Wednesdays, the (well) everyone sang during winter concerts.
explanation_ru: Глагол practised требует наречия more regularly, а исключение well в сравнительной степени имеет форму better: the more regularly…, the better…

prompt: The morning school bus reaches the gate in less time each week as the driver learns the hill road. Which sentence fits?
options: The bus arrives more and more fast at the school gate.
The bus arrives faster and faster at the school gate.
The bus arrives more faster and faster at the school gate.
The bus arrives the faster and faster at the school gate.
explanation_ru: Для постепенного ускорения с коротким наречием fast используется faster and faster без more и без артикля the.

prompt: I won't order from my favourite craft shop again. Shipping fees have climbed since January, and parcels now take two full weeks to reach my porch. Postage is getting more and (expensive), while delivery times grow (long) and longer. (much) I look at the checkout page, (little) I want to click buy.
explanation_ru: Длинное expensive образует more and more expensive, короткое long — longer and longer, а зависимость между действиями выражается парой The more…, the less…

prompt: My swimming turns are getting more and more better on Tuesdays.
answer: My swimming turns are getting better and better on Tuesdays.
accepted_answers: My swimming turns are getting better and better on Tuesdays.
explanation_ru: Частая ошибка — добавлять more and more к уже готовой сравнительной форме better; правильно — better and better.

prompt: Short silent cooking clips are changing how our studio shares recipes online. People rarely stop to read long written articles on their phones. These thirty-second videos spread more and (quickly), while written blog posts get less and (little) traffic. The (short) the recipe clip is, the (many) viewers watch it to the end.
explanation_ru: С глаголом spread нужно more and more quickly, с неисчисляемым traffic — less and less, а в паре «чем короче, тем больше зрителей» — the shorter…, the more…

prompt: According to the airport guide, the (light) your carry-on bag is, the (quickly) you pass through the security gate.
explanation_ru: В первой части конструкции the…, the… стоит прилагательное lighter (к глаголу is), во второй — наречие more quickly (к глаголу pass).

prompt: I used to panic whenever French speakers talked quickly on the radio. This term, I started playing evening news programmes while cooking dinner instead of worrying about grammar books. (much) I listen without translating word for word, (easily) I follow fast conversations. My teacher didn't believe my progress, because spoken dialogues are becoming (easy) and easier.
explanation_ru: В паре «чем больше слушаю, тем легче понимаю» артикль the обязателен в обеих частях (The more…, the more easily…), а постепенное облегчение передаётся через easier and easier.

prompt: Warning for walkers: the higher you climb, ___ the afternoon wind blows.
explanation_ru: Во второй части конструкции the…, the… нельзя опускать артикль the и нельзя добавлять more к форме colder; правильный вариант — the colder.

prompt: We moved our weekly office memos online, so our printers have used less and less paper over the past six months.
answer: We moved our weekly office memos online, so our printers have used less and less paper over the past six months.
accepted_answers: We moved our weekly office memos online, so our printers have used less and less paper over the past six months.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: с неисчисляемым существительным paper правильно употреблена двойная сравнительная форма less and less.

prompt: When you care for a fluffy rabbit, the (softly) you brush its coat, the (calm) it sits on your lap.
explanation_ru: Глагол brush требует наречия more softly, а состояние после sits в парной конструкции передаётся прилагательным calmer.

prompt: Parks staff added wide recycling bins beside every bench along the lake, and as the number of bins grew, litter dropped sharply. Which report sentence matches this?
options: The more bins we placed along the lake, tidier the grassy shore stayed.
The more bins we placed along the lake, the more tidier the grassy shore stayed.
The more bins we placed along the lake, the tidier the grassy shore stayed.
More bins we placed along the lake, the tidier the grassy shore stayed.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «чем…, тем…» артикль the обязателен в обеих частях, а у короткого прилагательного tidy нельзя добавлять more к форме tidier.

prompt: Takumi reminds new interns that the (carefully) they turn fragile old pages, the (long) the faded brush ink stays clear without cracking.
explanation_ru: Глагол turn сочетается с наречием more carefully, а длительность сохранения чернил передаётся наречием longer: the more carefully…, the longer…

prompt: During snowy Sapporo evenings, the (early) you pull the thick wool curtains across the glass, the (warm) the flat stays overnight without extra heating.
explanation_ru: Наречие early образует сравнительную степень earlier, а прилагательное warm — warmer: the earlier…, the warmer…

prompt: I couldn't stop laughing at the waffle kiosk, because ___ you pile on top, the harder it gets to eat cleanly without a fork.
explanation_ru: Парная конструкция с the harder требует в первой части именно the more перед неисчисляемыми существительными, а не the most или пропуск артикля.

prompt: If we invite friends earlier to chop vegetables with us, our dinner party feels much more relaxed. → The earlier …
answer: The earlier we invite friends to chop vegetables with us, the more relaxed our dinner party feels.
accepted_answers: The earlier we invite friends to chop vegetables with us, the more relaxed our dinner party feels.
The earlier we invite friends to chop vegetables with us, the more relaxed our dinner party will feel.
explanation_ru: Условие «если раньше…, то спокойнее…» перестраивается в конструкцию The earlier + подлежащее + глагол, the more relaxed + подлежащее + глагол.

prompt: Planning a December trip to the beach bungalows? Don't wait until autumn to reserve your room. (close) it gets to the holidays, (fast) the sea-view bungalows sell out. Meanwhile, nightly rates climb more and (sharply), leaving almost no budget options by November.
explanation_ru: Взаимосвязь времени и спроса выражается через The closer…, the faster…, а постепенное ускорение роста цен — через наречие more and more sharply.
